subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should ambient room_event runs keep strict effective visible delivery while using a separate session-stable prompt/tool contract for cache reuse?
rationale: The source-level bug path is clear, but the permanent behavior affects owner-only tool visibility and provider prompt-boundary policy for ambient room events, which requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
options.body: Land the linked PR after any remaining review/proof blockers are resolved, preserving strict visible delivery while stabilizing prompt/tool prefixes.

options.title: Preserve Current Tool Visibility
options.body: Require a different fix that keeps owner-sent room_event tool inventory behavior unchanged even if cache stability is harder.

options.title: Document Strict Behavior Only
options.body: Close the runtime-change direction and document that room_event strict delivery can change prompt/cache behavior when users mix it with automatic visible replies.

recommendation.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after any remaining review/proof blockers are resolved, preserving strict visible delivery while stabilizing prompt/tool prefixes.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room policy history that steipete authored and carried.
